terrain_shading: name "USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) hillshade, rendering rule Hillshade Gray". request "elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer exportImage, one 256 by 256 PNG per tile in EPSG:3857 for the 881 tiles that overlap the Montana outline at zooms 5 to 10 (sun from 315 degrees, 45 degrees up); the service description gives the data date, read at each build". units "8-bit grey, 0 to 255; stored as a grey JPEG at quality 80; every grey value kept as the service sends it (the transparency grey is not remapped)". timing "Monthly job with --refresh: the description and every tile are requested again. terrain_land_cover: name "National Land Cover Database (NLCD) 2021, land cover (MRLC)". request "www.mrlc.gov geoserver, WCS 1.0.0 DescribeCoverage for mrlc_display:NLCD_2021_Land_Cover_L48 (read at each build: its date keyword gives the cache month, 2023-06 today), then GetCoverage for the same 881 tiles, EPSG:3857, 256 by 256 GeoTIFF, nearest-neighbour sampling". units "NLCD class codes (2021 legend) classed into five tint colours (forest 41 to 43; shrub and grass 52 and 71; developed 21 to 24; crop 81 and 82; water 11), kept as palette PNGs with index 0 transparent; codes 0 and 255 are no data". timing "Monthly job with --refresh, with the shading. A layer name that is no longer in the service makes the land cover unavailable, with the reason in the block and on stderr". missing "A tile that fails three tries has no file (paper, with Data unavailable). A code outside the legend, or a truncated answer, is a failed try. Public domain information; Fees NONE."

- P1-04 (medium): a truncated 256 px PNG passed its check and was cached. check_shading_png now decodes the whole picture.
